I'm shopping for a new vacuum cleaner and I wanted everyone's opinions on which they prefer and/or brand and models.

This will be used on rug, hardwood floors, and tiles.

Uprights are (imo) really dicey on wood and tile. Many of them, especially Hoover, just send the crud out the back at a glass breaking fraction of the speed of sound. Basically (imo again) you can't use a beater brush on hard surfaces.

Canister seems to always give better results, especially on hard surfaces. But they are of course MUCH less convenient.

You CAN retrofit a central vac into a house if you have any sort of decent attic or crawl space. It is quite a bit of work hubby would have to do. But they work vastly better than either one and really only cost maybe twice as much.

The problem with all vacs is when the filter plugs and they quit working - usually long before the bag is actually "full". That was the glory of Rainbow - but I don't think they still make them. You could probably get a used one. They are a pain in the butt because you use a tub of water (that has to be dumped) instead of a bag. But they clean best of all. Only thing that can compare is a central vac that exhausts outside so it has no bag at all.

I am no expert on being a house wife or vacuums. But both my mother and grandmother have an upright Kirby vacuum. My grandmother's has lasted her decades. Same for my mother. She got her Kirby 20 years ago. I wish I could give you a price, but I can't seem to find one online. Definitely worth looking into.

My house is all hardwood flooring. I actually have an iRobot Roomba that I bought on a whim. Surprisingly it works extremely well.

Edit: The dogs HATE it though!
I gave up on fancy vacuums and just use a shop vac now. Tons of attachments, easy to clean filters and sucks up almost everything.

So, then you prefer a canister vacuum. ^.^

So do I

I would definitely recommend a canister if you do not have a central vac. I find uprights too limited and maneuverability is terrible. They do tend to be more powerful though. Canisters just sit on the floor and the power unit follows you. So all you really carry is the wand, which is light and maneuverable.

I have a Dyson DC23 motorhead and love it. The newer Dyson Cinetic Big Ball would be pretty good alternate, but sadly does not have the motorhead, just a turbine head. So cleaning rug would suffer a bit.

I have heard that Miele makes a very good canister. They do however use filters, so they need to be replaced and cleaned more often. Supposed to run forever though.

No matter which vacuum you get just remember that it is a machine like your car. As such it needs regular maintenance and cleaning to keep it working well for years to come.
I prefer a canister vacuum. It is less clunky, and lighter.
